batting.dismissal: c YV Dhull b AR Patel

batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b I Sharma

balls.text: oh Brar was ending the over superbly with a low full toss which Salt hits straight to deep square but bRabada lets it through to give away three bonus runs
the perfect yorker, dug out back to Brar
finally gets it right. Sees Rossouw advance and goes at his toes. Single to deep midwicket
another wide as he anticipates Rossouw moving across, but he doesn't
now down the wicket and intercepts the intended wide yorker on the full. Lofts him straight down the ground for six more
goes full and wide, but too wide

that's celever, but Rossouw is good enough. Rossouw is charging at him and also trying to go across and cover the wide line. Brar tries to stump him down the leg side, and first it there. Rossouw manages to get a touch on it, though
his first error possibly. Bowls a full toss at him, and Rossouw is charging at him anyway. Lofts him over midwicket for six
gets pace on finally, and deposits it. Not even a big followthrough. Almost just punches a length ball straight over long-on for a big one
slower bouncer, at his head, beats his attempt to hook. He checks with Rossouw if it was too high. Rossouw says no
full, wide and slow, thick edge as Rossouw looks to go down the ground. A single to deep point
slower again, crunched away but straight to extra cover. Gets a single off the fumble by Dhawan
goes back of the hand this time. Really wide, and manages to draw an edge from his big hit. However, it goes over short third and races away for four
finally Slat has arrived. Picks a slower ball early, gets under it, and goes big over wide long-on. The length is right in the slot
cleverly done by Brar. Bowls the change-up as Rossouw charges at him. Goes straight on his toes, and again manages to get hit straight to his deep fielder, deep midwicket. They steal a second, though
a juicy full toss hit straight to deep midwicket. Salt is berating himself
that full and wide plan is working. Hit straight to deep extra cover for one
reverse-sweep. Gets no power on it. Single to short third
full an d wide again, just the single down to long-off
full and wide as he was last over. This time Rossouw goes squarer than he did last time, and beats point for four
slower ball again, full and wide, and it is not called wide. Rossouw and Salt review the call. They think it is wide of the tram line. Replays show otherwise. DC lose the review
slower ball again, punched down to long-off for one
shuffles across to try to go leg, Ellis goes wide and slow, beats his sweep for lack of pace
in the slot, wide, and with pace on it. Rossouw loves these balls. Drives it over extra cover for four
slower ball, hit straight to extra cover, and another run-out missed. It is Dhawan again who misses from extra cover again. Rossouw brings up his fifty, and also gets an overthrow
on pace first up, and Salt drives this length ball to deep cover
excellent over comes to an end. No boundary. Low full toss hit just wide of deep midwicket for two
not looking to turn it. Just straight and on a length. Can't hit it but takes a risky single. The throw from cover is not on target
full and wide, can't get under it. Just a single to long-off
stays back to cut a length ball in front of square for one
arm ball, no room, beats him on the cut. Just outside off
full and wide, driven to deep extra cover
slower ball, on a length, 104ks, Shaw throws his bat at it, looking to go over deep midwicket, ends up skying it to deep square leg where he is caught at the boundary
moves outside off early, mis-hits a slower short ball to long-off for one
shows him the shuffle but stands his ground. Curran goes on a length but wide, just inside the tram line. Beats him
Rossouw shuffles across early, Curran goes wide with a slower ball, Rossouw cuts it hard, Brar makes a dicing save at deep point
finally he goes pace on, and into the slot. Angling down leg, and Rossouw clears the front leg and lofts it square over the leg side. This 91m six has gone out of the stadium
shuffles across, Curran bowls a slower bounce, Curran tries to hit it behind square but is beaten. Called wide on height, though
oh he picks the wide slower ball, drives it hard but finds the man at extra cover. A little bit either side, and it would be four
and he attacks immediately after reaching the fifty. Down the wicket, nowhere near the pitch of the ball, still manages to loft it straight of long-on for four
wide length ball, wrong'un, and he has a deep extra cover in place just for this. Just the single
it has been slow of late but Shaw gets to an IPL fifty. Punches this legbreak down to long-off for one
on a length, legbreak, headed towards top of off. Defended back to him
down the wicket, fired in, gets a single to deep midwicket
picks the wrong'un, opens the front leg and goes inside-out over long-off for a six. Rossouw is trusting this pitch and showing his array of shots

Rabada has hit Shaw in the hand again. Short, at his body, and Shaw is caught in a position where he can neither hook nor get out of the way. Throws up his hands in self defence, and is jammed against the handle again
yorker, on off, dug out for a single to point
a wristy pick-up shot. Takes this straight length ball, and sends it for a six over deep square leg. Lovely connection
crouches in his stance early. It looks like a ramp is on the cards, but stays in his stance, and opens the face on a straight length ball and manages to place it between the keeper and short third
on a length, pace on the ball, mid-off up in the circle, and Rossouw clears the front leg to loft him down the ground for a six over long-off
gets big from just short of a length, punched straight to extra cover
Chahar runs across between the umpire and t5he stumps to bowl this one. Ends up bowling a short one, which Rossouw is disappointed to have hit straight to long-on
wrong'un this time, ending in the same general area, played straight to cover again
legbreak, on a length, around off, punched straight to cover
on a length, on the pads, worked into the leg side for one
short of a length, pulled wide of deep midwicket for two
wrong'un, he picks it, opens the face, gets a quick single
on a length, angling in, dropped into the leg side for a single
lovely shot. Looks like a slower ball, yes at 121ks, and he drives this length ball wide of mid-off. A late opening of the face to place it. This is an offcutter
pushes this length ball straight to short cover

how is that for a sign that the pitch is good for batting? Rossouw pulls the first ball he plays, and he has timed it superbly and placed it just wide of long-on. The fielder has no time to get around

smashing catch by Dhawan. A well-disguised slower ball, Warner is looking for the big hit down the ground, but this is a legcutter, and the extra bounce and lack of pace takes a top edge. However, it looks like it will fall safe well short of long-off until you see Dhawan intercept it from cover, and put the final dive in to catch this over his shoulder. Celebrates it with a thaapi as in kabaddi
on a length, straight, flicked square on the leg side for one
slightly slow off the surface, ends up hitting it uppishly down the ground but the mid-on is all the way back on the boundary
on a length, honing in on top of off, punched in front of deep cover for two
skids through off a length, Warner drops and runs and makes the single
stunning shot.No pace on it, no room on it, but he has managed to somehow punch it powerfully enough to beat point to his left and deep cover to his right
opens the face, looking to use his pace, but can't beat Chahar at point

dropped by Chahar. Warner clears the front leg and goes for the big hit. This is a seam-up on-pace delivery, right in the slot, but it just shapes away. He ends up slicing a skier. Three men go for it. Chahar and cover are running back, Rabada is running in. Chahar gets to go for it, and drops it
a touch too full, a touch too straight, slog-swept square of deep midwicket for four. Bang in the middle of deep square and deep midwicket
similar length, punched into the off side for one
lovely wrong'un. Pitched on leg, Warner looking to work it to leg, and beaten oon the outside edge
oh he misses out. This is down the leg side, and he gets bat on it, but can't beat short fine leg. A fumble gets them a single, though
legbreak, not much room, cut away off a length, but can't beat backward point
short of a length, Warner goes back to pull it to deep midwicket
really full, nearly a yorker, runs off the inner half of the bat
slower ball again, on a length, just outside off, punched to point
slower ball, on a length, angling in, punched away to deep midwicket
full, on off, driven to long-off for one
on a length, slight seam in, hits the inner half of the bat for a single to leg
short of a length, angling in at off, pushed to point
digs this in short, and angles it too far down the leg side
on a length, legbreak, pushed down the ground for a single
runs down at him, Chahar shortens the length, but he can still play through the line and go inside-out over extra cover for four
slightly fuller and straighter. Played back to Chahar
well this doesn't seem a pitch for spin. You can go back and cut a length-ball legbreak and send it behind square for four. How do I know? Shaw just did it
goes back to pull a length ball, gets a single to deep midwicket
no turn, on a length, Warner goes back to punch it but can't beat extra cover
full, slight swing in, pushed towards mid-on for one
finds the edge but this is a slower ball. He has beaten him for lack of pace, and that lack of pace means it doesn't carry for a catch
repeats the shot. No room still. And it is just short of a length. He opens the face this time to find the gap between backward point and short third
lovely shot. I swear there is not a hair's breadth of room. He has taken this from off, stayed beside the line, and guided it between cover-point and cover
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for one
slower ball first up. Shaw has to check his shot, and plays it back to Ellis
punched hard down the ground, Dhawan prevents the boundary with a dive at mid-on, but they get a single
movement against the angle, which leads Shaw to play this length ball uppishly to mid-off

again not high enough for a short ball bowled at 136ks. Not much higher than the midriff, and Shaw goes flat out with this pull. Keeps it well in front of square to miss the square sweeper on the leg side. Gets six over midwicket
starts too straight for the second time this over, and then there is swing back in, which allows Shaw to glance it away for a four
dug in short, sits up, 135ks, but this one is slow off the surface and only midriff high. Shaw pulls it in front of square and over the in field
good bounce from short of a length, and beats Shaw who is throwing his hands at the width available

a hint of swing, starts too straight, and it is a wide down the leg side. Oh well, they have reviewed the wide after much deliberation. Jitesh reckons it hit something. He even appealed for the catch. This one didn't swing. It seamed in after pitching. The ball has missed both the bat and the pad. So PBKS have wasted a review

pulled in front of square. Takes this short ball from outside off, and his only focus is to hit it square so the long leg doesn't come into play. Not the sweetest connection but sweet enough to clear the midwicket boundary
short of a length, wide, punched away, but can't beat cover-point

Warner has decided you can trust the bounce on this pitch. Stays back, clears the front leg, and slogs it over leg side. It is just short of a length, and he still feels confident to play the shot. Over square leg for a six
short again, and at him. Shaw drops it into the leg side for one
back to shorter length, straight at him, defended back to him
and he provides width with the deep point pulled in. Shaw throws his hands at this wide length ball and goes over point
there is some bounce in the pitch. Short at 130ks, and it keeps climbing. Beats Warner's hook and still keeps rising, and Jitesh can't even get a hand to it
Warner finally finds a gap. Stays back to a length ball, cuts in front of square again, but this time in front of cover-point and finds the gap between him and cover
seams away after shaping up to swing in, Shaw punches this nicely wide of mid-off, but Livingstone saves three with a big dive to his left
short and wide, Warner tries to cut it in front of deep point, but can't beat the man at cover-point inside the circle
on a length, angling in, beats his flick and hits his thigh pad
places this short ball wide of deep point, and this time Shaw responds when he wants the second
that is a jaffa. Seams in at 143ks, and beats the inside edge as Shaw attempts a punch at it
again bottom hand off the handle on impact. Fingers are jammed
again extra bounce now. Warner fends with the bottom hand off. Gets a single to leg
this one doesn't come up, and Warner pulls this to midwicket. A bit of a toe end
fends at another short ball with the bottom hand off the bat
dug in short, into the body, Shaw fends, gets a single to leg. Warner wants two, but Shaw is not going back. Warner throws his head back
short, wide, cut away to deep point for one
this one seams away after shaping to swing, runs off the soft leading edge to deep cover for two
short of a length, outside off, punched to mid-on
short, wide, and Warner gets a bit of a toe end as the ball moves away after pitching. Cover-point fields to his right
stays back to a length ball, gets a bit of a bottom edge towards cover-point
short of a length, stands up a little outside off, punched to cover-point
hit straight to long-off. Gone for 94
thick outside edge to a length ball. Wide of deep cover. Could have taken two but doesn't run
he has missed out. Just overhits this one. A plum full toss outside off, and he has slogged this to deep midwicket instead of long-off. Misses it by a mile

high full toss, drilled over wide long-off for a six, and there is a lifeline coming PBKS's way as this has been deemed higher than the waist. DC are not even reviewing it. That is strange. Oh they have reviewed it. The cameras have missed the signal from Warner. It is just above the waist, and the no-ball call stays
wide full toss, drilled wide of deep cover for four
low full toss, he goes deep in the crease and lofts him over long-on for a six
full and wide, Livingstone tries to go over long-ff but is beaten. Just inside the tram line
oh Nortje. After a superb run-out earlier he goes at the wrong end. Livingstone has pushed this straight at him and run off. Nortje goes for the striker and misses that too
and this is getting over now. Nortje goes full, doesn't allow him to get under it. Livingstone turns down the single, which doesn't make sense to me as the last ball is coming up
nails the yorker, and the inside edge goes straight to short fine. A yard either side, and he would have got four
no he is not looking for the single. The short ball is outside off, and beats his waft. Livingstone rushes through for a bye, makes it in with a dive, but Brar doesn't. Nortje has run him our
shuffles across early, I am expecting him to move back but he doesn't. Nortje goes full and straight on the leg stump. Knocks the leg peg out
misses the yorker. Curran is deep in the crease, and drives this over extra cover for four
superb comeback. Low full toss, nearly a yorker, and just inside that blue tram line. Livingstonje doesn't even try to reach it because he is standing back on leg stump
that's a gift. A length ball down the leg side, and Livingstone is now waiting in his crease. Flicks it over short fine for another six. The third of this over
yorker, on leg, drilled to long-on for a six
Curran shows why you can't be farming the strike with him. Slower ball, short of a length, outside off, and Curran upper-cuts it over backward point for a flat six
nails the yorker, hits hie toe, Livingstone doesn't want the leg-bye but Curran pushes him through
Livingstone is keeping this alive. What a single-handed effort so far. Mukhesh goes for the straight yorker, misses his length, and Livingstone gets under it to clear long-on with ease
wide outside off. Looking for the wide yorker but goes too wide

nearly a four but Kuldeep saves three at short fine leg. Livingstone will not be happy. This is the second leg-side offering he has missed this over. Flicks it to the left of short fine but Kuldeep puts the dive in
for a moment it looked like this was the game. Just a short-arm punch down the ground to a length ball, and it has cleared long-on by six feet or so

shuffles across first ball to try to go over short fine, is hit high on the pad, and takes a leg-bye. Khaleel has a huge lbw shout, not given, and they review it. Hit just above the knee roll but he is deep in the crease. He might even have got himself outside the line. Khaleel is fine on. the height but it is an umpire's call on the line of impact. Curran survives, DC keep their review

mis-hit by Shahrukh. Straight to long-on. If he had responded to Livingstone and taken the second, Livingstone would have been on strike and wouldn't probably have hit a length ball straight down the throat of long-on. Sloppy batting from PBKS batters other than Livingstone
misses out. Possibly smart bowling. He has seen Livingstone shuffle, and slipped a length ball on the pads. Gets a leg-bye, wants the second off the overthrow but sent back
and he has launched the free hit into the beautiful night sky of Dharamsala. Stands on off stump, deep in the crease, and gets under this length ball. Straight back over his head for a humongous six

wide full toss, he has cued it and wide of the keeper for four. That brings up fifty. More importantly, it is called no-ball on height. And Khaleel has reviewed it. Replays confirm it is too high, and the no-ball stays
goes shorter, quicker, but the only flaw with the delivery is the width available. Shahrukh tries to capitalise and upper-cut, but is beaten
and he hits a six first ball. Nortje goes short, but not as high as the last one. Also Shahrukh is taller. He pulls it down the ground and over wide long-on
Jitesh had been set up to fail here. He has to go after every ball with no time to get in. Tries to pull, gets a top edge, and is caught by Khaleel at long leg
just no timing as he tries the big hit. Nortje bowling the superb hard length. Hitting the bat high
into the hip, just can't get under it. Hit straight to midwicket
on a length, hit hard, but along the ground and straight to long-off
low full toss again, but it is dipping, and he can't get under it. Just the single to long-on
low full toss, Livingstone crunches it over midwicket for four. Just about staying in the contest
slower ball, down the leg side, and Livingstone misses out. No connection at all. Hit on the pad
nearly a yorker. Can't get under the low full toss. Just the single to long-on
follows him as he backs away. Takes his arms out of the shot. Just the single to deep midwicket
makes room early, gets a full toss, drills it wide of long-off for four
cuts this away to deep cover. So he has bowled to his field to get out of the over
can't get a big hit again. Mis-hits this to long-on for a single
down the wicket, yorked, just the single to short third
another slog attempted and this time he is beaten both in the air and off the pitch. Misses the outside edge again
full and straight, pushed to long-on for one
done in by the wrong'un. Lovely bowling. Flights it, asks him to go for the slog, and then it turns the other way but somehow misses the off stump
he just cannot get out today. Goes for the pull. Late into it. Gets a top egde, but it falls short and straight of short third. Two more
shanks a pull but clears midwicket. That is fifty for Taide. Off 38 balls
sharp bouncer, Salt has to fly to collect this. This is pace like fire. Taide doesn't even try to hook it
slower ball, on a length, punched to deep cover for one
right in the slow. Misses his yorker by some way, and Livingstone clears the front leg to drill it back over his head for a flat six
flicked off the hip for a single to deep square
short, wide, a thick edge on the cut, and the short third is among the tallest men on the field. Ishant Sharma leaps for the catch but it clears him
yorker, just outside off, worked into the leg side for one
on a length, angling in, worked into the leg side for one

even this one falls safe. Taide looks to go over long-off, but Axar's angles from around the wicket takes the ball away, and the edge falls at the 30-yard line. Neither cover nor long-off can get there
Taide finally getting a move on. Superb shot, using the pace of Axar as he goes down on a knee and sweeps him behind square
a quick length ball down the leg side, and he nudges it with a sweep, fine of short fine

nails the yorker, and Taide is caught napping at the non-striker's as Livingstone attempts the overthrow. DC have missed two run-outs in one ball. First at the non-striker's, then at the striker's off the overthrow. Livingstone is nowhere near his crease but the throw is wide
full toss, and another mis-hit from Taide. Outside edge for one as he looks to go over leg
down the wicket, yorks himself, hit straight to extra cover
full and straight, can't get under it. Single straight to long-on
short of a length, into the hip, and Livingstone helps it along the angle with a pull. Goes low but wide of deep square
full ball, drilled hard, straight of long-on, where Axar dives to save two runs for DC
quicker, on a length, pushed into the leg side for one
and now the salt to the wound. Kuldeep drops this short, and Livingstone pulls it big over deep midwicket for a six

another drop. Taide's struggle set to continue. Kuldeep has had a second catch dropped off his bowling. Taide is under extreme pressure to at him, but Kuldeep pulls his length back, draws a mis-hit straight to long-on but Yash Dhul spills it
punched wide of deep cover for two

another wide down the leg side as he fires it down. Oh no, not given a wide so Taide contests it and sends it upstairs. It is down the leg side, has missed the bat, missed the pad, but has flicked the protruding thigh pad. Surprising he didn't feel it. Review lost
wide down the leg side
wrong'un, punched to deep cover for one
down the wicket, Axar shortens the length, doesn't allow him he freedom. Off the thick inside edge for one
on a length, no room, pushed to short cover
freebie, full and outside leg, and he has flicked it to short fine for one
slower in the air, some turn away, punched down the ground for a single
flicked to deep midwicket for one
revere shot as Axar goes quick and on a length, and gets enough bat on it to clear short third with ease

dropped at deep midwicket. Livingstone finally has a slog, nowhere near the middle of the bat, and it goes straight to Nortje who gets right behind it, takes up his hands fingers pointing upwards but spills it
punches this length ball wide of long-on but they take only the single
wrong'un. Or maybe the topspinner? Taide doesn't pick it at all and is beaten on the inside edge
on a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for a single
driven to long-off with the turn. Another single
full, just outside off, driven down to long-off
punches this length ball down to long-off for one
on a length, quick, wicket to wicket. Defended back to him
Prabh feels the pressure from Taide not doing much. Runs at Axar looking to go with the angle and over long-on. However, he gets the inside half of the bat and is caught at long-on
slog sweep but not enough power in it. A single to deep midwicket

hit on the back of the leg as he tries a quick single. Salt is appealing for obstructing the field, and they go upstairs. I don't think Prabh was ever up to no good there, but let's see the replay. And it confirms he didn't change his direction
on a length, straight, flicked into the leg side for one

lovely yorker, and he is nearly run out. Dipping, and right on his toe. Prabh digs it out and strats running on instinct. Taide doesn't move because this has gone just to the right of the keeper. Salt misses with the direct hit, though
thick inside edge to a straight length ball, gets a single to leg
that is out of the middle. On a length, on off, and this time he nails the slog. Way over deep midwicket for six
for lucky runs. Looks to slog this over leg, but gets an edge to this length ball, and it goes fine of deep third
full, really full, flicked straight to midwicket as Taide's struggle continues
big lbw shout first ball as he gets it to straighten up the line, but Taide has got an edge on it
short of a length, punched to deep third for one

another edge falls short. Nortje goes short, Taide gets a top edge on the hook, I think that is a mis-hit six, but it has been hit straight into the helmet and flies towards mid-off. No fielder there. He is too disoriented to run the single

wow that bounce. Dug in short of a length, Prabh fends at it, and the ball flies off shoulder of the bat. Axar Patel sprints to his left from point, puts in a full-length five too, but can't get to it
slower ball, outside leg, 128ks, beats his attempted pick-up shot. They get a leg-bye, though
oh he finally hits one out of the screws, and gets a big six for it. On a length, angling in, no movement - Nortje has bowled it cross seam anyway - and Taide lofts him over long-on
lucky there. Looks to go hard at a length ball, which gets big on him, goes off the high part of the bat in the air, but is wide of mid-off and gets him four

the movement lasted just three overs. Ishant has shortened the length now. Prabh sees this is short of a length, and there is no deep third. So he opens the face and guides it wide of short third for a third straight four
first he beats mid-off to the left, now to the right. On a length, headed for top of off, but Prabh drives it hard down the ground and sends it hurtling straight of mid-off
Prabh smashes this. Short of a length, just outside off, and he slaps this wide of mid-off for four
cramps him up for room, hit straight to cover-point
misses out. This is angling down leg, and he can play the pick-up shot, but makes no connection. They get a leg-bye, though
down the wicket, Ishant shortens the length, punched to cover-point
lovely shot. This has seamed away too but he catches up with it, and pushes it between point and cover-point for two. Nearly a second straight maiden for Khaleel
seam movement. Also extra bounce. From a good length, just outside off. Beats him
inswinger again, down the leg again, and this time they get a leg-bye
this one swings back in. Perhaps some seam movement too after pitching. Hit on the pad but down the leg side
short of a length, get5s the width, cuts this hard, but can't beat backward point
full, outside off, swinging away, left alone
a touch too full from Ishant, and Prabh goes down on a knee and lofts this over mid-on for four
no fear of failure from Prabh. Beaten last ball, and he has lofted this inswinger down the ground. Not the best connection but clears mid-off
Ishant is pitching it up, and Prabh is tempted into the big drive. Beaten by the away seam movement
the first run comes with a push to the left of mid-off
full, on off, defended towards mid-on
the Test-match length, and swing away from him against the angle. Dhawan tries to go over mid-off, but the movement takes away the outside edge to first slip

again, full, wide and swinging it away. Beaten on the big drive again, and Khaleel is not happy with the wide call. Even I feel it is harsh. He convinces the captain to review it. It has beaten his bat well inside the tram lines. The fielders have changed ends already assuming this will be overturned. They are right. The wide is overturned, which means this is a maiden over
full, wide swinging away, beats his waft at it on the outside edge
on a length, no swing, but slight seam away to off. Defended to cover
seams back in from a length, and hits him high on the thigh pad
looking for swing, overpitches it, but hit straight to mid-off
swing back in, on a length, defended
